_comment: BRAND IDENTITY (contract §9) — one identity mark per VENDOR, beside the one
per project. The engine OWNS this data; the design system defines its presentation.
It is a LOOKUP TABLE, not per-session state: it changes when a brand is added,
which is roughly never. Served whole at GET /api/brands.
brandHue is the DESIGNED glyph input (integer 0-359);
brandColor is the literal vendor colour and is for large/About
surfaces ONLY. They differ on purpose: Codex's and Ollama's real marks are
achromatic, so deriving a field from brandColor would collapse both to the
same grey and make them indistinguishable in a list — which is the one job
the mark has. Hues are ASSIGNED, and >= 40 degrees apart (validated at boot,
see src/engine/brands.ts): at most ONE achromatic brand (omit brandHue — it
renders unbranded), ceiling seven chromatic brands plus generic.
brandMark is a KEY in the design-system vocabulary, never an inline SVG: marks are
drawn at ~20px and at pane size and one asset set must serve both. Assets
vendor from the vendored aurora/brand-marks/ (96x96 viewBox, currentColor,
72x72 safe area). There is deliberately NO brandMarkDark — a currentColor
`generic` is MANDATORY: it is what an unknown or class-2 vendor resolves to,
and a renderer must never be left with nothing to draw.
